supervisor.complete_task: Action tasks (create/send/delete/like/add/update/play...) finish with complete_task() and NO answer. Pass answer= only when the task asks a question; then give just the bare value (number/title/name), not a sentence.
supervisor.show_account_passwords: List of {account_name, password}. Compare account_name with == for the app you need; file_system has its own separate password/login.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: Takes NO arguments (no access_token). Raw result is {'date': 'Saturday, May 20, 2023', 'time': '02:20 PM'}, but prefer today = sandbox_today(fn): a DATE object (today.year, str(today); not subscriptable). System clock is wrong.
phone.login: username is the supervisor's PHONE NUMBER (not email). Use the phone number from the task header.
phone.search_contacts: Paginate to the end. Filter family/friends/roommates by the relationship= param or by the 'relationships' list on each item; print one contact first. Contacts, not other apps, define who a person is.
phone.show_contact_relationships: Lists the exact relationship labels in the contact book; use one of them verbatim in search_contacts(relationship=...).
spotify.show_playlist: Detail view lists songs as songs[].id; library listings give song_ids instead. Works without access_token for public playlists.
spotify.show_album: No access_token. Songs are in songs[] (key 'id'). Genre/play_count/release_date are NOT here: call show_song(song_id) per song.
spotify.show_song: No access_token. Source of genre, play_count, release_date (ISO datetime: parse_day(s).year), duration (SECONDS), artists[{id,name}] and rating (the song's overall rating: use it for 'highest rated'; my own review only for 'I rated').
spotify.show_current_song: Needs access_token. Shows the playing song; error if nothing is playing.
spotify.search_songs: Fuzzy, PAGINATED (default 5; use paged). Has artist_id / album_id filters (use songs_by_artist); verify items yourself. No access_token.
spotify.show_song_library: Only songs explicitly added to the library. Items have the SINGULAR key song_id (playlist/album library items have song_ids); song_ids(list) handles both. 'Library' ≠ playlists ≠ liked songs: use the endpoint the task names.
spotify.show_playlist_library: Paginate (page_limit=20). Items carry song_ids already: do not expand with detail calls. 'My playlist' comes from here (owner.email = me), not from search_playlists.
venmo.show_transactions: Paginate fully. Use min_created_at/max_created_at with full-day bounds (T00:00:00 .. T23:59:59) and the direction/user_email filters; print one item to see its keys first.
venmo.create_payment_request: Sends a request FOR money to user_email; create_transaction SENDS money. Put the exact description text from the task in description.
venmo.add_to_venmo_balance: Never use to fix insufficient funds for a payment: retry other cards with pay_with_any_card instead. Only call when the task explicitly asks to add money.
file_system.login: Separate login: username is the supervisor email, password from the file_system entry in the supervisor passwords. Its token is not valid for other apps.
file_system.create_file: Params: file_path, content, overwrite (bool), access_token. Use overwrite=True when replacing an existing file. Paths look like ~/folder/name.ext.
file_system.show_directory: Returns absolute paths like /home/<user>/...; if show_file/move_file give 422 for them, use the ~/... form. Param is directory_path (no 'path').
file_system.show_file: Returns {content, ...}: parse the text in 'content'. Print it fully before extracting amounts or names.
phone.search_text_messages: Params: query, phone_number (filter to ONE contact's thread), only_latest_per_contact, page_index, page_limit, sort_by. To read a whole conversation pass phone_number=<contact number> and paginate; default page size is only 5.
spotify.show_song_queue: NOT paginated (no page_index). Items have position, is_current, song_id. Songs 'played so far' = position <= the is_current item's position (played_so_far(items)). Print the queue first.
spotify.show_song_reviews: Params song_id, user_email (my own reviews); NO access_token. Items have song_review_id (use it for update_song_review/delete), rating, user. Paginated.
spotify.play_music: Needs access_token and AT MOST ONE of queue_position/song_id/album_id/playlist_id. For 'play the X of my playlist/album', check afterwards with show_current_song that the right song plays; if not, play the collection first, then queue_position.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Paginated: use paged(). Items carry song_id. 'X that I liked' = X intersected with this list, where X is the named library/playlist/album, not all liked songs. Skip songs already in show_downloaded_songs (download_song gives 422 for them).
spotify.show_recommendations: Paginated (use paged()). Items are SLIM: song_id,title,album_id,duration,artists; NO genre/release_date. Call show_song per id (load_songs) before filtering by genre or year.
venmo.show_payment_cards: NOT paginated (no page_index). Items have payment_card_id, card_name, expiry. Call it directly (or via paged, which falls back to one call).
venmo.create_transaction: SENDS money to user_email (match the person by contact email). Optional payment_card_id. On insufficient funds retry other cards (pay_with_any_card); do not add to the balance or add cards unless asked.
venmo.show_social_feed: Friends' transactions, PAGINATED (use paged). Items: transaction_id, amount, description, created_at, sender{name,email}, receiver{name,email}. No actor/target keys.
venmo.show_sent_payment_requests: Paginate fully. Items have NO status key: pending = approved_at and denied_at both None; also receiver{name,email}, created_at, amount. remind_payment_request(payment_request_id=...) sends a reminder for one. Filter by receiver email and age in days yourself.
file_system.move_file: Params: source_file_path, destination_file_path, access_token, overwrite, retain_dates. Moves/renames in one call; pass the FINAL full path once. List the destination first; use overwrite=False unless asked to replace.
phone.show_alarms: PAGINATED (default 5 per page): use paged(). Check enabled/time fields on every alarm; print them all.
simple_note.search_notes: Matches note TITLES only (fuzzy), paginated (default 5): use paged(). Print the titles and pick the ONE note for the task's topic; show_note it and read its full content.
simple_note.show_note: Returns the note with its full 'content' text; print it fully before extracting anything.
venmo.search_users: Fuzzy and paginated: near matches always appear. Accept a user only if the email equals the requested one exactly (has_account).
spotify.review_song: Only CREATES a review: 409 if I already reviewed the song. To change a rating use update_song_review (set_song_rating does both).
spotify.update_song_review: Params review_id (the song_review_id from show_song_reviews), rating, access_token.
spotify.show_following_artists: PAGINATED (default 5): use paged(). Items have artist_id.
spotify.show_song_privates: Needs access_token. Shows my private data about one song (e.g. liked / my review).
